contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian, Gloria Romanorum issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]VALEN[--?N] PP AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing left holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: GLORIARO [MANORVM]. In exergue: T[?R](-). Diameter: 16.00mm, Weight: 1.93gms, die axis: 12
